title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
summary: Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeffrey Dean submitted "Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space" to arXiv on January 16, 2013. The paper proposes two model architectures for efficiently learning continuous vector representations of words from very large data sets and evaluates the learned representations on syntactic and semantic word-similarity tasks.
significance: A documented natural-language-processing and representation-learning milestone, preserved at day precision for the paper-submission event supported by the primary arXiv record.
